execution: Only after root supplies frozen candidate; own copy only

controls.name: api-target-byte
controls.mutate: Change an API identifier without updating pins

controls.name: output-pack-overlap
controls.mutate: Put output at or under immutable pack

controls.name: test-env-injection
controls.mutate: Supply Rust test filters, shuffle and ignored flags plus external TMP paths
controls.must: Scrub variables and execute exact expected inventory with owned temporary paths

controls.name: compiler-identity
controls.mutate: Supply a fake unsupported compiler identity using an owned launcher
controls.must: Reject before source compilation with captured selection receipt

controls.name: diagnostic-unrelated
controls.mutate: Synthetic wrong compiler error, nested unrelated error, duplicate JSON key, wrong primary span or omitted private field
controls.must: Diagnostic validator refuses all unrelated or incomplete failures

controls.name: method-inventory
controls.mutate: Synthetic missing, duplicate, ignored, failed, wrong filtered count or extra method output
controls.must: Inventory validator refuses partial or unrelated execution

controls.name: case-layout-inventory
controls.mutate: Synthetic missing, duplicate, changed case or layout line
controls.must: Case and layout validator refuses incomplete observations

controls.name: timeout-owned-group
controls.mutate: Owned launcher/child fixture sleeps beyond a shortened test-only bound
controls.must: Kill and reap owned group, preserve timed_out failure and cleanup

limitations: Some controls may be exercised directly against pure validators when runtime would repeat expensive full runs.
No authority from syntax inspection alone; normal actual Rust host checks remain required.
No adversarial filesystem or arbitrary public File qualification claim.
